task_completion.description: Agent logs into Odoo with the 'admin' account.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Odoo dashboard or calendar view is visible with the user 'admin' shown in the top right corner.

task_completion.description: Agent navigates to the Calendar module and locates the Friday of the upcoming week.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Calendar interface is displayed, and the view is focused on the correct Friday date.

task_completion.description: Agent checks if the 'Board Room' is available at 14:00 on that Friday.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent views the calendar for the Board Room or checks existing meetings at 14:00 to see if a 'Board Room Reserved' event exists.

task_completion.description: Agent selects the 'Board Room' if free, or 'Engineering Lab' if the Board Room is occupied.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The meeting creation dialog or the final event details show the 'Location' or 'Room' field set to 'Board Room' (if available) or 'Engineering Lab' (if Board Room was blocked).

task_completion.description: Agent sets the meeting name to 'Project Sync' and the time to 14:00-15:00.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The event creation window shows the title 'Project Sync' and the start time as 14:00 (2:00 PM) with a 1-hour duration.

task_completion.description: The meeting is successfully saved and appears on the calendar.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The calendar grid displays the 'Project Sync' event at the 14:00 slot on the correct Friday.

integrity.description: The agent used the Odoo web interface rather than executing database or terminal commands.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse movements, clicks on Odoo buttons, and typing into web forms.

integrity.description: The agent actually navigated to the date and checked availability rather than guessing the room.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory shows the agent looking at the calendar or room schedules before finalizing the booking.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the live Odoo instance.
integrity.visual_evidence: The URL bar shows the Odoo instance address and the UI elements respond dynamically to clicks.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The meeting must be named exactly 'Project Sync'. It must be scheduled for the Friday of the upcoming week at 14:00 (2:00 PM) for a 1-hour duration. The agent must check the 'Board Room' first; if a 'Board Room Reserved' event exists at that time, they must use the 'Engineering Lab'. Otherwise, they must use the 'Board Room'.
